verdict.rationale: Floot is an app-building platform, so offering registrable outbound webhooks for platform events is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions webhooks or event subscriptions. Push notifications, email, scheduled jobs, and the ability to build backend endpoints are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not documented outbound HTTP callbacks a consumer can register for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
